changes: Wrap sort run-file and final-checkpoint writes in one optional adapter batch.
Prefer atomic batches when supported; otherwise retain existing single-file staging or legacy-write behavior.
Keep transaction bookkeeping charged independently until commit/rollback settles, including after query cancellation.
Share a generic checkpoint batch helper for later window integration; preserve both primary and rollback errors.

scenarios: success publishes run and final checkpoint together
cancellation before commit preserves prior checkpoint and leaves no run
final target version conflict leaves no earlier run publication
write failure after staging rolls back all files
assertions: legacy and single-staged adapter paths still pass

remaining: Window checkpoint writer still needs batch integration.
Adapters without atomic batch capability cannot provide multi-file rollback guarantees.
Cancellation after successful commit cannot retract published data through rollback.
Remote adapter commit semantics and real cloud fixtures are not proven by these controlled scanner/in-memory spill tests.
